name: figma-design-screens
title_zh: 在 Figma 里从零长出一屏产品界面，先问清再动手
tagline_zh: 被拒稿、要贴齐现有产品、或压根没有视觉方向时用它：它先逼你把屏幕要解决什么讲清楚，再落图层。
tagline_en: For rejected designs, matching an existing product, or no visual direction yet: it makes you state what the.
desc_en: Use when designing, building, or changing a product screen, flow, or component in Figma — new screens, states, redesigns, or edits to already-approved work. Use when a design result was rejected, when a screen must match an existing product, or when starting design on a product with no visual direction yet. why_zh: 它把「先定意图再画」写成了硬流程：状态、边界、已有组件复用都在动手前确认，而不是事后补。
why_en: It hard-codes intent-before-pixels: states, edges, and reuse of existing components get settled before a single frame is drawn.
limit_zh: 只在 Figma 里干活，且要能读到你现有的组件库和变量；纯审计、写文档、不动屏幕的活儿它不接。没有设计系统可对齐时。
limit_en: Figma-only, and it needs read access to your existing components and variables. Pure audits or docs without changing screens are out of scope.
title_en: Grow a product screen in Figma, asking before drawing
